importantFindings.title: A frozen-edit approval covers its path forever, and the pre-commit hook reads it from the working tree instead of the staged index
importantFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:89 skips any frozen path that appears in `allowed`. The set comes from approvedFrozenEdits (l.98-107), read at l.248-251 from the working-tree archive/README.md, even in --cached mode. Nothing ties an entry to one change or one date, and the section split at l.100 runs to the end of the file rather than to the next heading. DOCS_SYSTEM.md rule 6 describes a single approved removal of personal data, not a standing waiver.
importantFindings.reproduction: Scratch repository with check-docs.mjs copied into scripts/, a COMPLETE manifest, archive/a.md and an archive/README.md that has an empty '## The one exception' section. (T3) Stage an edit to archive/a.md and append, without staging it, the entry '- 2026-10-09 `archive/a.md`' to the index. `node scripts/check-docs.mjs --cached --frozen-only` prints 'Frozen edit approved…' and 'PASS: frozen documents unchanged' and exits 0, so the commit goes in without its approval and CI then refuses it. (T5) Commit the approval together with the edit. Later, `git rm archive/a.md`: the same check prints 'approved' and PASS and exits 0, so the archived file can be deleted for good. Smaller fix: read the index from the commit being made (`git show :archive/README.md` in --cached mode, the file itself otherwise) and approve only entries that are new against the base, `allowed = new Set([...approvedFrozenEdits(now)].filter((p) => !approvedFrozenEdits(atBase).has(p)))`. Stop the section at the next heading with `.split(/^## /m)[0]`. That is about 5 lines, and each approval then covers exactly one change.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/DOCS_SYSTEM.md rule 6; archive/README.md 'The one exception'; H1 adversarial checklist ('a hook that ... passes ... when it should fail')

qolFindings.title: The flaky-entry format exists in two copies and is still matched as a substring; five spec names are suffixes of other spec names
qolFindings.evidence: run-e2e.mjs:95 prints `${file} › ${title}`. milestone.mjs:109-111 rebuilds the same string and calls `backlog.includes(entry)`. The suffix pairs in tests/e2e are crews/u09-crews, duties/u08-duties, knowledge/u03-knowledge, persistence/reopen-persistence and students/u02-students. docs/working/BACKLOG.md:5-7 already says entries are written in backticks.
qolFindings.reproduction: node: with the backlog line '- `u08-duties.spec.ts › keeps the plan` …', the flaky test {file:'duties.spec.ts', title:'keeps the plan'} counts as filed (true). The title 'opens the app' counts as filed by a line for 'opens the app offline' (true). No two specs share a title today, so this is latent. Smaller diff: export `flakyEntry = (t) => `${t.file} › ${t.title}`` from e2e-report.mjs, use it in both places, and match `` backlog.includes(`\`${flakyEntry(test)}\``) ``.
qolFindings.specRef: AGENTS.md §10 (derive instead of copy); 04 H1 item 4

qolFindings.title: check-docs states the frozen set three times: classify(), frozenProblems() and the git pathspec
qolFindings.evidence: scripts/check-docs.mjs:39-46 (archive/ledger classes), :84-88 (archive/, CHANGELOG.md, PAGE_CHANGELOG, .evidence) and :258-262 (the pathspec).
qolFindings.reproduction: Smaller diff: in frozenProblems, `const docClass = classify(file); const frozen = docClass === "archive" || (docClass === "ledger" && (evidenceOf === undefined || completedAtBase.has(evidenceOf)))`. That replaces 4 lines, and a ledger added to classify() is frozen without a second edit. The pathspec could stay as a pre-filter.

qolFindings.title: Dead export and wasted work in check-docs' frozen-only mode
qolFindings.evidence: `export const PLAN` (check-docs.mjs:16) is imported nowhere; only PAGE_CHANGELOG reaches the test. In --frozen-only mode, lines 125-135 still parse the working-tree manifest and list and stat every Markdown file, though only the full mode uses them. A working-tree manifest left mid-edit therefore crashes the pre-commit hook with a stack trace even when the staged manifest is valid.
qolFindings.reproduction: grep shows no importer of PLAN. `node scripts/check-docs.mjs --cached --frozen-only` passes in 0.6 s, so this costs correctness, not time. Smaller diff: drop `export` from PLAN, and move `manifest`, `statusOf` and `markdown` into the `if (!frozenOnly)` block, printing the count from there.

qolFindings.title: ci.yml fails open when the scope step prints nothing
qolFindings.evidence: ci.yml:48-53: verify:all runs only when `browser == 'true'`, and `verify` runs when it is `!= 'true'`, which includes an empty output. ci-scope.mjs:77 prints only behind its main-module guard, and its header says anything unknown runs everything.
qolFindings.reproduction: Not reproduced as a misfire: on this machine the guard held under a different-case path and an 8.3 short path (both printed browser=true). One-word fix: `if: steps.scope.outputs.browser != 'false'` for the Playwright install and verify:all, `== 'false'` for verify. Missing output then runs everything.
qolFindings.specRef: docs/DEPLOY.md ('A push whose CI fails is not deployed')

qolFindings.title: Any check run named 'verify' on the previous tip vouches for it, whatever its workflow or event; the header overstates what a rewritten range does
qolFindings.evidence: ci-scope.mjs:35-40 filters only on name and status. Until H1 the workflow also ran on pull_request. Those runs test refs/pull/N/merge but attach their 'verify' check run to the head SHA, so a passing PR run could stand in for that SHA's failed push run, because the latest completed run wins. The header (l.8) says a rewritten range runs everything, but when the old tip is still fetchable the tree diff decides. That is still safe, because tree equality is what the induction needs.
qolFindings.reproduction: Reasoned from the API and the removed `pull_request:` trigger (git diff HEAD -- .github/workflows/ci.yml). This is historical only now. A same-size alternative that pins the event and the workflow: `GET /repos/{repo}/actions/workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=<before>&event=push&status=completed`, taking the newest run's conclusion. Reword l.8 to 'an unknown old tip'.

qolFindings.title: The contract states the docs-only CI rule without the condition that makes it safe
qolFindings.evidence: 03_TECHNICAL_DECISIONS.md:231-232 says a documentation-only push 'runs `verify` instead'. It leaves out 'when CI passed on the previous tip' and archive/. §6.1 l.244-245 says 'only a green CI run means the suite passes', but a green docs-only run inherits the previous tip's suite result and does not run the suite itself. .claude/skills/milestone-close/SKILL.md:88-89 says the pre-commit hook 'checks privacy', and it now checks frozen files too.
qolFindings.reproduction: Compare these lines with ci-scope.mjs:1-10 and scripts/git-hooks/pre-commit:8-10.

qolFindings.title: CI's two Playwright retries are not in the contract, and CI's flakes are recorded nowhere
qolFindings.evidence: playwright.config.ts:90 sets `retries: process.env.CI ? 2 : 1`. 03 §6 (l.212-214) allows 'one local retry'. CI is the authority (§6.1), yet a test that passes there on its third attempt is green: its FLAKY line stays in the log, and the artifact upload runs only `if: failure()` (ci.yml:59).
qolFindings.reproduction: Read the three lines. Smaller diff: `retries: 1`, one value matching the contract, removes the ternary. Or keep two in CI and upload test-results/e2e-flaky.json with `if: always()`.
qolFindings.specRef: 04 H1 item 4 ('a flaky test listed in evidence and the backlog as a defect'); 03 §6

qolFindings.title: The page changelog is enforced as append-only, but it holds page states that the design process edits in place
qolFindings.evidence: DOCS_SYSTEM.md:24 and 48-50 make docs/design/07_PAGE_CHANGELOG.md a ledger. 06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md:99 says the changelist 'defines the states', and 07 line 3 holds 'Stato: FROZEN per l'implementazione 0.2.0' plus dated amendments within each page section. The classification predates H1 (HEAD's DOCS_SYSTEM.md). H1 is what makes the hook and CI enforce it.
qolFindings.reproduction: Replay (wildcard): of the last 150 first-parent commits, 11 edited 07 in place, among them 85a7544 'Complete UX1 phone-preview corrections' (15 lines added, 3 removed) and d72501c (1 added, 1 removed). All would now be refused. 0.4.0 plans no page work, so this bites the next UI cycle. Either move the state register into the rulebook (a contract) or say in rule 6 how a state change is appended.

qolFindings.title: The hook is stricter than CI when the completion commit is amended
qolFindings.evidence: In --cached mode, check-docs takes completedAtBase from HEAD (l.234-244). During `git commit --amend` of 'Complete <ID>', HEAD already marks the milestone COMPLETE, so an amend that touches its own evidence is refused. CI's base is the previous pushed tip, and CI would accept it.
qolFindings.reproduction: Scratch T4: with X COMPLETE at HEAD, a staged edit to .evidence/X/v.json is refused, exit 1. An amend sees the same HEAD. Workaround: `git reset --soft HEAD~1`, then commit again. Mention it in the skill's step 6, or accept it.
qolFindings.specRef: H1 adversarial checklist ('a hook that blocks a legitimate commit')
